protocol: source-holdout (Alpaca fit benign; PI-benign test-only; attacks restored from prior seed)
rules: Raw sources only (Simsonsun Dataset_2, MPDD, PI jsonl, Bravanskycompact CSV)
Leave-one-source-out: held-out attacks never in train/val
Exactly 200 Alpaca train + 100 Alpaca val on every fold
Shared 200 test benign = PI-benign only; identical on every fold including Neuralchemy
PI-benign never appears in train or validation
Four-source folds have identical train/val/test sizes
Exactly 200 train-pool attacks from EACH other source
Attack val = 20% split within each attack-source piece; Alpaca uses fixed 200/100
Method A fixed paper threshold; tune Method B / fold baselines on val only
